## Pipeline (one composite; each stage many-in, one-out)

| stage | in | out | owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Encode | DomainGraph | Spec | Products |
| Validate | Spec | ValidSpec | Core |
| Analyze | ValidSpec | Report | Core |
| Extend | ValidSpec, Boundary | Report | Core |
| Certify | Report | Cert | Products |
| Circulate | ValidSpec | Circ | Products |
| Quantize | Report, Circ, Policy | Evidence | Products |
| Classify | Cert, Evidence | Verdict | Products |
| Attribute | Report, DomainGraph, Verdict | Finding | Products |
| Receipt | Finding, Cert | Receipt | Products |
| Join | Receipt, Receipt | Receipt | Products |

| G4 | root | Formal | Gauge invariance: the loop verdict is unchanged by adding any exact cochain (delta p) to the observed edge data w. | S.encode.valid | Encode | Formal | Encode is valid by construction: for every well-formed domain graph, the emitted spec passes Validate (endpoints exist, u != v, map shapes de x dim, identity only when dims agree, at least one of x, w). | A.encode.endpoints, A.encode.shapes | encode_valid |
| S.encode.index | Encode | Formal | Encode fixes a bijection between domain relations and spec edges that preserves order; Attribute uses its inverse. |  | encode_index_bij |
| S.encode.mode | Encode | Formal | Mode honesty: the spec carries w iff every relation has an observation; a partial observation set is rejected, never silently mixed. |  | encode_mode |
| S.circulate.exact | Circulate | Differential | Circulate computes, for each fundamental cycle of a spanning forest, the transported sum of w around it; for scalar maps with exact rational rates the computation is exact. | A.circulate.exact-zero, A.circulate.linear, A.circulate.basis-size |  |
| S.quantize.only-crossing | Quantize | Types | Quantize is the only place an f64 becomes a Nat; Classify accepts Ticks<Tol> only (newtype), never f64. |  |  |
| S.quantize.threshold | Quantize | Property | Threshold faithfulness: ticks(v) >= ticks(tol) iff v >= tol, and ticks is monotone; values are measured relative to the domain tolerance (reports span ~41 decades, absolute fixed point fails). |  |  |
| S.quantize.floor | Quantize | Property | Fail-before-freeze for policies: a tolerance below kappa * max(certified residuals, cert_coclosed) is refused (BLOCKED policy), so numerical noise can never cross the threshold. |  |  |
| S.quantize.nonfinite | Quantize | Property | NaN, inf and null report values quantise to BLOCKED, never to 0. |  |  |
| S.certify.wf | Certify | Property | Report well-formedness: h1 = dim_C1 + h0 - dim_C0 (graphs); exact_share + harmonic_share = 1 within cert; unique = (h0_relative == 0); any violation is BLOCKED(report). |  | rank_nullity_and_euler |
| S.classify.total | Classify | Formal | Classify is a total, terminating function to a closed verdict enum. | A.classify.uncertified, A.classify.undetermined, A.classify.xonly, A.classify.mono, A.classify.circ-only, A.classify.loop-iff, A.classify.disc-iff | classify_total |

| A.attribute.fill | Attribute | Formal | A fill is marked determined only when the extension is unique; write-back requires determined. |  | fill_determined |
| A.attribute.x-only | Attribute | Types | For x-only input the loops field is NotApplicable, never an empty list (an empty list would read as a negative finding). |  |  |

## How each layer becomes code (Touchstone atom pipeline)

| layer | proved in | enforced in | shipped in | gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L0 Global | composition of L1 (derivations above) | weakest-link tier check (tests/ontology.rs) | receipts + join (sheaf-kit) | every step below |
| L1 Stage / interface | Bend LAWS.bend (Formal leaves) | Haskell Laws.hs, same ids | one Rust module per stage | bridge tables A, A', B |
| L2 Atom | Bend PROOF.bend (+ --verdict) | Haskell, exhaustive small domain | Rust fn + same-id test | mutation L0 (Bend), L2 (cargo-mutants) |
| L3 Product | Bend instance of its parent atom | Haskell | per-product crate | product fixtures + differential vs core binary |

## Holes found by deriving each global law from its parts

- **H1 G5 needs S.quantize.floor.** Neither Spec v1 nor SPEC.md bound the tolerance from below; on clean data the core returns harmonic share ~1e-33, so a tolerance of 0 makes clean data a loop conflict. The floor law closes it.
- **H2 G4 contradicts Spec v1 L4-L7.** Spec v1's proven verdict uses material SHARES (>5%). Adding an exact cochain changes shares, so the verdict is not gauge invariant; E2a shows a real arbitrage at share 2e-5. L4-L7 must be replaced by A.classify.circ-only, and their Bend proofs redone.
- **H3 G2 had no crossing stage.** Spec v1 computes per-mille shares in the Python tool and hands them to Bend: the float-to-Nat crossing had no law. Quantize is now an explicit stage with threshold, floor and non-finite laws.
- **H4 G6 was only cited.** Component locality was covered by a dense-count core test only; batching keys into one spec (P2) relies on it, so it now needs a differential law (batch vs split).
- **H5 loop localisation.** Harmonic energy spreads over 51 of 52 edges (S2); localisation must come from circulations (Circulate), cross-checked against the core (I.circulate.analyze), with disagreement surfacing as a HOLE.
